college: College of Social Sciences and Humanities
overview_text: The combined major in history and linguistics integrates the study and analysis of human history together with human language. Successful students in the major emerge with a sophisticated understanding of the relationship between culture, language, and human society over time; a command of structural linguistics; research and writing skills; and competence in key methodologies of historical and linguistic analysis.
